key_catalyst: Microsoft and Meta earnings anticipation amid intense AI spending scrutiny, triggering aggressive pre-market risk reduction
reasoning: Mega-cap tech earnings from Microsoft and Meta after the close are driving pre-market de-risking, compounded by an accelerating AI/semiconductor rotation where chip stocks fell 7-9% yesterday and the Fed meeting beginning with a 31.5% hike probability. Recent history shows QQQ dropped -1.90% on July 23 and -1.12% on July 24 on similar AI spending concerns after Alphabet and Tesla earnings, and today's pre-market -1.12% indicates the sell-off is continuing rather than being absorbed.
